name: Riley Randolph
source:
[i]"Rowan is such a big city, don't you think? One day, I'd like to take you here again when you're free—"[/i]

The successor to House Randolph and Aprose's older brother. He was loved by those around him due to his mischievous and kind nature.

He treasured his younger sister, to the point of being excessively attached, but every now and then he took a strict attitude with her when it was for her sake. He was always thinking about how he wanted his younger sister to have a better fate.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/mistonia/characters/riley/]Aksys Games[/url]]
